<rules>
- Cite every insight you rely on as [i:INSIGHT_ID], using the id exactly as given. Cite at least three different insights when three or more are given, and cover every route that appears.
- Use these sections, in this order, as Markdown headings: "## Problem", "## Who is affected", "## Evidence", "## Why now".
- Every bullet under "Who is affected" and "Evidence" ends with a citation. Every sentence that contains a number or a date carries a citation.
- Copy every account count, mention count, route count, renewal count and ARR figure from the fact sheet. Never compute, add up or round a number yourself; write an ARR figure only as it appears in the fact sheet, in pounds.

Never put quotation marks around a paraphrase, a fragment of your own wording or a phrase from the fact sheet; when unsure, paraphrase without quotation marks.
- Name a customer only when a cited insight in the same sentence belongs to that customer.
- Do not claim more than the evidence shows: no "all customers", no scope wider than the cited accounts, and mention any cited insight that points the other way.
- Do not recommend a solution.
</rules>

## Problem
Teams struggle to coordinate supplier and policyholder interactions across different regions because their communications and task tracking are disconnected. This leads to delays, errors, and inefficiencies in handling claims.

## Who is affected
- Thistlecombe Mutual, which is counting on improved management of suppliers and policyholders across multiple regions [i:98e8c29dbf07d279].
- Duncastle Auto, which is struggling with supplier communications and task tracking [i:ac71e446fb1f70b7].

## Evidence
This problem has been raised by 2 accounts [i:98e8c29dbf07d279][i:ac71e446fb1f70b7]. It has been mentioned 2 times [i:98e8c29dbf07d279][i:ac71e446fb1f70b7]. All mentions came from the sales route [i:98e8c29dbf07d279][i:ac71e446fb1f70b7]. The combined Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) from these accounts is £1,060,000.0 [i:98e8c29dbf07d279][i:ac71e446fb1f70b7]. Thistlecombe Mutual has an ARR of £980,000.0 [i:98e8c29dbf07d279] and Duncastle Auto has an ARR of £80,000.0 [i:ac71e446fb1f70b7].

## Why now
The feedback from Thistlecombe Mutual on 2026-10-28 [i:98e8c29dbf07d279] and Duncastle Auto on 2026-10-14 [i:ac71e446fb1f70b7] indicates active and recent concern from customers. Thistlecombe Mutual's renewal is on 2027-09-01 [i:98e8c29dbf07d279] and Duncastle Auto's renewal is on 2027-08-19 [i:ac71e446fb1f70b7], placing the issue within the current renewal cycle. No renewals have occurred in the last 90 days [i:98e8c29dbf07d279][i:ac71e446fb1f70b7], highlighting the importance of addressing this before the upcoming renewal dates.
</previous_draft>
